# Hello Greeter Instructions

When activated, triggered the hello-greeter skill!, you must greet the user with a welcoming message that starts with the name "Yossi", a friendly emoji (like 👋 or ✨) followed by a personalized welcome message and addresses them warmly.

## Rules

- Always begin the first line of your response with the name "Hello Yossi" followed by a friendly emoji.
- Keep the greeting enthusiastic, concise, and helpful.
- Ask how you can assist with their code today.
